title: Changing Your Marlowe & Finch Unlimited Plan
content:
*Help Centre — Marlowe & Finch Unlimited*

Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plans are ranked from 1 to 6. A move to a plan with a higher rank is an upgrade; a move to a plan with a lower rank is a downgrade.

| Rank | Plan |
|---|---|
| 1 | Unlimited Standard Monthly |
| 2 | Unlimited Student Annual |
| 3 | Unlimited Standard Annual |
| 4 | Unlimited Express Monthly |
| 5 | Unlimited Express Annual |
| 6 | Unlimited Next-Day Annual |

The rank, not the fee, decides the direction of a change: Unlimited Express Monthly (rank 4) ranks above Unlimited Standard Annual (rank 3), so a move from Unlimited Standard Annual to Unlimited Express Monthly is an upgrade.

## Plan change terms (the same on every plan)

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| When an upgrade takes effect | Immediately, with a prorated charge |
| How an upgrade is charged | The new plan's fee less the unused value of the current period, the unused value being taken by remaining days |
| When a downgrade takes effect | At the next renewal |
| Refund on a downgrade | None |
| Most plan changes per billing period | 1 |

## What these terms mean for a member

**Upgrades and the renewal date.** An upgrade does not wait for the member's renewal date: it takes effect immediately, and the charge is the new plan's fee less the unused value of the member's current period by its remaining days.

**Refunds on a downgrade.** Nothing is refunded when a member moves to a lower-ranked plan; the downgrade takes effect at the member's next renewal.

**Two changes in one period.** A member cannot change plan twice in the same billing period: at most 1 plan change is made per billing period.
